limitations: One matched campaign per variant in 32/48/64 order; no alternated independent trials or significance claim.

TTFT includes reasoning; SSE chunk gaps are not token inter-token latency.
No GPU timeline captured; no claim about GPU idle recovered.
Startup estimate is an admission estimate; host RSS/MemAvailable alone do not describe GB10 unified-memory consumption.
OS page cache remains intact across variants; the isolated port excludes external inference requests.
Snapshot-count test changes prefix retention only; n-gram storage remains the SSD path in every arm.
